standard_prerequisites: The representation of sections over a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale open as a homotopy colimit of sections against perfect complexes, valid for every object of the quasi-coherent derived category
The base change lemma for derived sections against perfect objects
Derived tensor with A_n commuting with homotopy colimits
Invariance of sections under the etale base change identifying U_n over the level with U
core_obligations: By the computing-sections-as-colimit lemma there is a system of perfect complexes E_m with RGamma(U, K) = hocolim RGamma(X, K tensor E_m), and the formula holds for every object of D_QCoh, in particular for F_n
Applied to F_n the chain runs RGamma(U_n, F_n) = RGamma(U, F_n) = hocolim RGamma(X, F_n tensor E_m) = hocolim RGamma(X_n, F_n tensor E_m restricted to X_n)

The base change lemma for perfect objects turns each stage RGamma(X_n, F_n tensor E_m|_{X_n}) into RGamma(X, K tensor E_m) tensor A_n, and derived tensor with A_n commutes with the homotopy colimit, giving RGamma(U, K) tensor A_n = RGamma(U_n, F_n)
proof_roadmap: Represent sections over U as a homotopy colimit against perfect complexes, valid for all of D_QCoh
Run the same representation for F_n and identify the stages through the etale base change
Apply the perfect base change lemma levelwise and commute the tensor with the homotopy colimit
